title: Unary Reinterpretation of the Initial Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic machine over the binary alphabet and let $x$ be a binary word. Reinterpreting the initial configuration of the input-normalized machine associated with $M$ on $x$ as a configuration on the all-ones word of length $|x|$ gives the initial configuration of $M$ on that all-ones word.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic machine over the binary alphabet
replaced: For every deterministic machine $M$ over the binary alphabet and every input $x$, the reinterpretation of the initial configuration of the input-normalized variant of $M$ on $x$ equals the initial configuration of $M$ on the all-ones word of length $|x|$.
